notes.title: A lot of small fixes and basement is getting reworked.
notes.content:
Puzzle size have now been reduced to 9 pices.

Fixed bug with santa seeing thru walls.

Added more sound effects and ambience.

The dream forest tree now have sound.

new/reworked basement but still WIP

notes.title: Fixed audio bugs and ragdoll bugs,
notes.content:
Fixed issue where the house ambience would be gone after going to the forset.

Fixed issue with ragdolls getting duplicated.

Fixed issue with movement.

notes.title: No more Permadeath
notes.content:
Permadeath have been removed and you will now get put in a forest where you will have to find your way back.

Several sound tweaks.

Removed the starting cutscene.

notes.title: New animations and gameplay fixes.
notes.content:
Added some new animations for santa.

Eating animation.

Sleeping animation.

Stationary hunting animation?!??

And now he looks at you when he hunts you.

Puzzle pieces are now scatterd around the house instead of being infront of the puzzle.

The clock on the door into the clockroom blocked santa but that is now fixed.
